title: Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges such as portal users or users without assigned roles, to access private import-format files by sending crafted requests referencing records outside their permission scope. The vulnerability leads to unauthorized reading of private file contents without proper permission checks.
